5705.title: Read-only runtime trees reject completed host artifacts
5705.rootCauseOneLine: Recursive chunk copying preserves read-only directory modes; awaited temporary-package cleanup rejects after the tarball is built and renamed.
5705.proposedFix: Make only service-owned temporary directories owner-writable for cleanup, including nested directories; review archive-mode and cleanup-failure semantics explicitly.
5705.caveats: Real artifact service and npm pack reproduced twice without root privileges. HTTP mapping inspected and covered by existing route tests; NixOS, macOS, and enrollment not rerun. No automatic PR because permission and packaging changes are excluded by the rule. Test and logs are inline under reports repository policy.
